title: The *Capability* Floor
dek: A freely downloadable Chinese model now builds cyberattacks at 89% the rate of the most capable restricted US model. The FTC just started asking questions.

stories.short: Chinese model matches US cyber AI
stories.label: end-to-end exploits, vs 56/410 for the most capable US model
stories.headline: Open-weight models have caught up to restricted frontier cyber capability
The regulator arrives as the capability it was meant to govern goes open-weight

stories.short: Vietnam AI law live, GITEX opens
stories.headline: Vietnam's AI law is enforceable since March. The US is still on voluntary commitments.

still_signal: The model layer can contain capability. Regulators arrive before the capability spreads. Consumers adopt AI through new platforms. This week stress-tested all three. None held.
